content.short: Boop pop is a project of collectible NFTs backed by a Comic and rewards with a lottery on ADA Cardano.
content.description:
The Boop Pop NFTs collection and the digital Comic tell the adventures of 3 characters.

In addition, each NFT purchased serves as a lottery ticket for the weekly draws. Boop Pop will allocate 50% of the sales income to distribute in lottery and extra prizes. In short, the Boop Pop project is: NFT + Comic + Lottery in ADA
